repository.description: OCI repository, e.g. docker.io/w00dson/clusterdrill. No tag or digest here - see digest below.

digest.description: Immutable image digest. A mutable tag (including 'latest') is rejected by this pattern, matching clusterdrill local install's own refusal of non-digest images.

existingSecretName.description: Name of a Secret, already present in the release namespace, with a 'password' key. Create it yourself or have the CLI create it before running helm - this chart never generates or accepts a password value.
